gloss: just the two of us; alone together

definitions.gloss: just the two (of us, of them); alone together
definitions.explanation: Two people on their own with nobody else present.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}きり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}したい→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to talk with you alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧{二人|ふたり}きりになった。
examples.english: The children have left home, and now it's just the two of us, husband and wife.

notes:
〜きり means "only, just": ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧きり (all alone), {二人|ふたり}きり. Also said ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧っきり, more casual and emphatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二人|ふたり}きり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be left alone together
- {二人|ふたり}きり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk alone, privately
- {二人|ふたり}きり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: time alone together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二人暮|ふたりぐ}らし→二人暮らし：33614_futarigurashi⟧: two people living together
